totalWordsInBraces = 0
maxWordLength = 0

def countWords(s):
    s = s.replace("_", " ")
    s = s.strip()
    s = " ".join(s.split())
    parts = s.split(" ")
    if len(parts) == 1 and parts[0] == "":
        return 0
    return len(parts)

def main():
    n = int(input())
    s = input()
    indices = [-1]
    for i, ch in enumerate(s):
        if ch == '(' or ch == ')':
            indices.append(i)
    i = 1
    totalCount = 0
    maxLen = 0
    outsideText = ""
    while i < len(indices) - 1:
        startIdx = indices[i]
        endIdx = indices[i + 1]
        insideStr = s[startIdx + 1:endIdx]
        countWordsInside = countWords(insideStr)
        totalCount += countWordsInside
        outsideText += "_" + s[indices[i - 1] + 1:startIdx]
        i += 2
    outsideText += "_" + s[indices[-1] + 1:]
    outsideText = outsideText.replace("_", " ")
    outsideText = outsideText.strip()
    outsideText = " ".join(outsideText.split())
    outsideWords = outsideText.split(" ")
    for w in outsideWords:
        if len(w) > maxLen:
            maxLen = len(w)
    print(f"{maxLen} {totalCount}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
